knowledge.name: Synthetic standards snapshot
knowledge.detail: Four fictional distribution standards with revisions, sections and pages.

knowledge.name: Vetted quick-reference table
knowledge.detail: Eight fictional vetted rows with value, citation, vetting date and status.

knowledge.name: Interpretations, reviews and jobs
knowledge.detail: Fictional unvetted interpretations, a review queue, risk weights and two jobs to scope.

intelligence_processing.name: Two-tier answering
intelligence_processing.detail: Returns a vetted value when one exists and a labeled, cited interpretation when it does not.

intelligence_processing.name: Review preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds a draft review request with sections cited, reviewer and target date.

intelligence_processing.name: Re-vetting detection
intelligence_processing.detail: Flags quick-reference rows whose standard was revised since vetting.

intelligence_processing.name: Job scoping
intelligence_processing.detail: Sums risk-factor weights into a band and computes crew-days from base and per-unit effort.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file agent exposes six routable operations through local Brainstem chat and API surfaces.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Six skills and two synthetic knowledge files support natural-language preview while the agent stays Draft.

management_reporting.name: Standards review queue
management_reporting.detail: Pending reviews, waiting time against target and rows due for re-vetting.

management_reporting.name: Quick-reference sheet status
management_reporting.detail: Rows per standard with vetted and re-vetting counts.

management_reporting.name: Job scope summary
management_reporting.detail: Risk score and band, effort estimate, applicable standards and open items.

tools.name: EngineeringStandardsAgent portable RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with six deterministic read-only operations over bundled synthetic records.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the pilot with six skills and two knowledge files; publishing requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Microsoft SharePoint
tools.detail: Approved production seam for the standards library and quick-reference tables; not connected.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams
tools.detail: Documented seam for review requests to standards engineers; the package submits nothing.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every standard, value, citation, review and job is fictional and never for design use.

supporting_features.name: Vetted versus unvetted labeling
supporting_features.detail: Every answer states its tier; interpretations are never presented as approved.

supporting_features.name: Engineer authority
supporting_features.detail: Only a standards engineer vets interpretations or re-vets rows.

supporting_features.name: No design approval or side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never approves a design, changes a standard, submits a review or releases work.
